title: Research: provenance of agent commits (GitLab signed commits, push rules, protected branches, SLSA)
goal: How does GitLab verify GPG, SSH and X.509 signed commits, with a push rule rejecting unsigned ones? How do protected branches and merge request approval rules limit what a bot or agent account can push or merge? What does SLSA build provenance require? How does GitLab CI generate artifact provenance?
